questions.question:
The bar diagram represents the number of E-Cycles parking in a metro station from 12:00 PM, to 6:00 P.M. 

What will be the total collection from 2:00 PM. to 6:00 P.M. when the parking charge is Rs. 3 per hour? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4bb80d7522807785ad30de7ef8aa1199ccb56db6ea456e1d1367b8f10ab852d.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Parking charge = Rs. 3 per hour.

**Formula Used:**

Total collection = Total number of cycles × Parking charge per hour

**Calculation:**

At 2 pm total cycles = 45

At 3 pm total cycles = 25

At 4 pm total cycles = 45

At 5 pm total cycles = 55

At 6 pm total cycles = 45

Total cycles = 45 + 25 + 45 + 55 + 45 = 215

Total charge for all cycles = 215 × 3 = **Rs. 645**

when we simplify this ratio, we get

**311 : 554**

⇒ Rs. 50 lakh

Study the following graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5a3e9556274c761a5f8ca6fc9988bd765ff3c0a74e86d214a161d0bfa514387.png] 

The expenditure of the company in 2016 is what percentage more than the average revenue (per year) in 2014, 2015 and 2018 (correct to the nearest integer)?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The expenditure of the company in 2016 = 320

The total revenue of the company in the year 2014, 2015 and 2018 = (260 + 300 + 375) = 935

The average of the total revenue of the company in the year 2014, 2015 and 2018 = (935/3)

⇒ 311.66 

Required percentage = [(320 – 311.66)/311.66 × 100]

⇒ (8.34 × 100)/311.66

⇒ (834/311.66)

⇒ 2.67% ~ 3%

**∴ The required percentage is 3%**

questions.question:
The bar graph shows the number of players of a college taking part in two games for five years:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7aae1bb489948ff5fce2d7531357167e74cddc425ad95c871af04d142f4488a3.png] 

What is the total number of players playing cricket and football in 2019 and 2020?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The number of players playing cricket and football in 2019 and 2020.

**Formula Used:**

Total number of players = Number of players in cricket + Number of players in football

**Calculation:**

Let's denote the number of players in cricket in 2019 and 2020 as C₂₀₁₉ and C₂₀₂₀, and the number of players in football in 2019 and 2020 as F₂₀₁₉ and F₂₀₂₀.

Total number of players in 2019 and 2020 = C₂₀₁₉ + F₂₀₁₉ + C₂₀₂₀ + F₂₀₂₀

⇒ Total number of players in 2019 and 2020 = 90 + 32 + 29 + 34

⇒ Total number of players in 2019 and 2020 = 185

**The total number of players playing cricket and football in 2019 and 2020 is 185.**

questions.question:
In the following graph the production of raggi in 4 consecutive years are plotted. In which year the production of raggi is minimum?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/052a712914c2a77845dbba9ff16097902ce0dbe46c4434f8a6e84c3105ef6b61.png]
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Production of ragi in 2017 = 4000

Production of ragi in 2018 = 4500

Production of ragi in 2019 = 3000

Production of ragi in 2020 = 2500

Since the production of ragi in 2020 is minimum that is 2500.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**

If a pie chart is drawn for the data related to the expenditure of the company in five years, then the central angle of the sector representing expenditure in 2016 will lie between.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total expenditure in 5 years = 210 + 300 + 350 + 450 + 490

⇒ 1800

Here 1800 is 360° 

Expenditure in 2016 = 350

So, 350 = (360°/1800) × 350

⇒ 70°

**∴ It will lie between 68° and 71°**

questions.question:
The Bar Graph shows the Production and Sales of Mobile handsets of various companies A, B, C, D, E & F in a month.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58d3211c61b55dee313e5bc02dc79e63c9eee380a55a0d0db24b7796fd16ee7a.png] 

Which Company had the highest percentage of sale with respect to its production?
questions.solution:
The sale of company A with respect to its production = 650/900 = 13/18

The sale of company B with respect to its production = 300/700 = 3/7

The sale of company C with respect to its production = 150/300 = 1/2

The sale of company D with respect to its production = 450/850 = 9/17

The sale of company E with respect to its production = 330/550 = 3/5

The sale of company F with respect to its production = 400/600 = 2/3

After comparing the above ratio, we get 13/18 is the greatest of all

∴ The sale of company A is highest with respect to its production.

questions.question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

Number of Male and Female employees of a Company working in Five Offices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebfc9fdb41ca38c272035b9fb0cd059839d1e4ed3b0578f27b6cef615ea734b5.png] 

In which office of the company is the number of male employees 25% more than the average number of female employees in all five offices?
questions.solution:
Calculation: 

The average number of female employees in all five offices = (180 + 220 + 400 + 450 + 350) ÷ 5 = 320

25% more than 320 = 320 + 320 × 25% = 400

As we can interpret from the bar graph given above, only office D has 400 male employees. 

**∴ In office D of the company, the number of male employees is 25% more than the average number of female employees in all five offices.**

questions.question: What is the average maximum temperature of the city per day for the given ten days?
questions.solution:
The sum of temperature of the city for ten days = 38.3 + 40.3 + 30 + 28.7 + 35 + 37.4 + 38.4 + 39.3 + 40.2 + 12.2 = 339.8 ° C

⇒ The average temperature of the city = The sum of the temperature of the city/number of days

⇒ The average temperature of the city = 339.8/10 = 33.98°C

∴ The average temperature of the city for ten days is 33.98°C.

questions.question: The average of marks obtained by S3 and S5 is what percent less than the marks obtained by S9?
questions.solution:
The sum of marks obtained by S3 and S5 = 87 + 99 = 186

⇒ The average of marks obtained by S3 and S5 = 186/2 = 93

⇒ The marks obtained by S9 = 100

⇒ Required % = [(100 – 93)/100] × 100

⇒ 7%

∴ Required % is 7%.

questions.question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd0c09452490048ac68f0a2e45ab07953eafc05496822bc9db7cf7c1c9dafaba.png] 

The total exports of the country in 2014, 2016 and 2018 are what percentage more than the total imports in 2015 and 2017 (correct to one decimal place) ?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The total exports of the country in 2014, 2016 and 2018 = (440 + 370 + 450) = 1260

The total imports in 2015 and 2017 = (410 + 450) = 860

Required percentage = [(1260 – 860)/860 × 100]

⇒ (400/860 × 100)

⇒ 46.5%

**∴ The required percentage more is 46.5%**
